text: Understanding databases is essential for modern software. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables, which are organised into rows and columns. To get information from them, you write queries using a language like SQL. Good data modeling helps you plan the structure of your tables before you start. Indexes are also important because they make queries much faster, especially when your tables contain a lot of data. NoSQL databases work differently and are useful for flexible or large-scale data. Choosing the right type depends on your project's needs.
